about.developer_label: Made with love and care 🩵 by
about.fun_fact_content: This game was built using React and tailwindcss✨
about.p1: We believe games should be of high technical quality and easily accessible. That's why all games are currently available at no cost, and we ensure the experience is smooth and enjoyable for everyone, without complicated logins, registration information, or additional downloads.
about.p2: Multiplayer or Local Play: Play with friends or family on the same screen, or enjoy remote play with fun and smooth sessions.
about.p3: Free Now: Everything is free in the beta version. We want you to try and enjoy before anything else.
about.p5: If you're interested in what happens behind the scenes, we share our experience in building this platform, and how we combine high performance, efficiency, and innovative technologies like state management, caching, and real-time multiplayer gameplay. All to ensure a smooth and scalable experience, while benefiting from technical learning and experimentation.

gameSetup.description: Choose a set of logos and grid size, enter player names, then start guessing! Players take turns asking questions and eliminating logos.

instructions.step1: 1. Each player secretly chooses one logo from the grid
instructions.step2: 2. Each player asks yes/no questions in turn
instructions.step3: 3. Click on logos to eliminate them based on answers
instructions.step4: 4. First one to correctly guess opponent's logo wins the challenge!

instructions.rule1: When it's your turn, you have exactly 5 seconds to say 3 things that match the category shown on screen.
instructions.rule2: Speak your answers out loud - don't write them! Think fast and say the first things that come to mind.
instructions.rule3: After time's up, other players vote on whether your answers were valid. Get majority votes to earn one point and build your winning streak.
instructions.rule4: Get a streak of 3 correct answers in a row to receive a random power-up! Use it wisely to help yourself or disrupt others.
instructions.rule5: The winner is the player with the most points at the end. Remember: the game is about quick thinking, laughter, and friendly chaos!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Game Hub respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) in Saudi Arabia and other applicable laws. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your data when using our platform. Currently, there is no user authentication, so we do not collect account-related data such as email or passwords.
privacy.p2:
We collect the following types of information automatically through analytics tools when you interact with the platform:

• **Usage Data**: URL paths, entry/exit points, page titles, queries, sources, referrers, channels, domains, hostnames, tags, and events (such as starting or completing game sessions).

• **Device and Browser Data**: Browser type, operating system (OS), device type, language, screen resolution, and environment.

• **Location Data**: Approximate location based on IP address, including country, region, and city.

• **Other Data**: Any names or identifiers included in URL states (such as player names in game links like /ar/guess-logo/game/.../haider/yousef), which may reveal personal names if provided by users.

We do not collect sensitive personal data unless voluntarily provided in game content. If payments are made, third-party service providers handle financial details; we do not store payment information.
privacy.p3:
• To operate and improve the platform (such as analytics to understand user behavior and improve games).
• To provide features such as online multiplayer and session tracking.
• For marketing and advertising (such as targeted ads based on location or usage).
• To comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud.
privacy.p4:
We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with:

• Service providers (such as analytics tools, hosting services) under strict confidentiality.
• Legal authorities if required by Saudi law.
• In case of business transfer (such as merger).
privacy.p5: We use reasonable security measures to protect your data, including encryption where appropriate. However, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.p6: Under PDPL, you have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your data. Since there is no authentication, contact us with details of your interaction (such as IP or URL) to exercise these rights. You can opt out of analytics by disabling cookies or browser settings.
privacy.p7: We use cookies and similar technologies for analytics. You can manage them through your browser.
privacy.p8: The platform is not intended for children under 13 years old. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy.p9: We may update this policy. Changes will be posted here with the update date.
